rows.en: Sneak in and retrieve it.
The enemy's deployed a GN-X squadron on defense. They're MS with GN Drive Taus.
They're mobile suits fitted with GN Drive Taus.
Pseudo or not, the enemy has finally assembled a force that can rival Gundams...
Hey, Arios. Don't go stirring up that much worry.
Relax, we'll throw the enemy into disarray. Whoever they are, I'm aiming and firing!!
Whatever the enemy is... I'm aiming and firing!!
Sorry if we don't leave you guys anything to hunt!
All right, guess it's about time we got started.
Cherudim, commencing operations!
Arios, moving to disrupt the enemy!
This is Operation Area B. Our objective is to recover the "Gundanium alloy."
The enemy refines ore mined from the rubble at a facility deep inside to make Gundanium alloy.
There's a reservoir they need for that,
and it looks like they're storing high-purity Gundanium alloy somewhere past it.
Sneak in and bring it back.
Hey, what are the enemies here?
Kaima Robots, and Yummies.
Figured as much. This place reeks of Yummies.
Deep in there is where the most Yummies show up in this whole Cube.
It's perfect for raking in Medals! I wonder if there's a Yummy nest in there or something!
I wonder if there's a Yummy nest in there or something!
A Yummy nest...? It couldn't be...
We'll go ahead and draw their attention. We're counting on you for the Gundanium alloy.
All right! Work time, work time!!
This is Operation Area C. Our objective is to seize the weapons the enemy has in storage.
There's a storehouse at the very back of this area. Let's grab any gear there we can use.
The enemies here are mobile dolls. Emotionless killing machines.
So what?
...To me, space mines are more of a pain than a single mobile doll.
Mobile dolls...
What do they even fight for...?
We've fought Leos once already.
I believe I understand what mobile dolls are like.
We've fought Leos once already.
I know what mobile dolls are like.
We've fought Leos once already.
I believe I understand what mobile dolls are like!
We've fought one of those Leo things once already.
I understand what mobile dolls are like.
We've fought Leos once already.
I have a rough idea of what mobile dolls are like.
We've already fought Leos once, y'know?
Mobile dolls are a cakewalk!! A total cakewalk!!
We've fought Leos once already.
Mobile dolls are nothing to me!
Several MS have been spotted here too. They're all tough foes. Don't let your guard down.
The enemies here are a rank stronger than in the other operation areas.
We've also asked the Maganac Corps for reinforcements.
We of the Maganac Corps are honored to fight alongside Master Sandrock.
Thank you.
Even this might not be enough. So please don't let your guard down.
You'd better be prepared for the worst.
Of course. We are fully prepared.
All right, time we headed out.
Right.
We'll go on ahead as a diversion. Make sure you pull off your part too.
Make sure you pull off your part too, okay?
So you've come...
Now learn the true might of us, the GN-X squadron!
We no longer have any reason to fear Gundams!!
We won't let you go one step further!
GN-X squadron, moving to attack!
You obtained "Emerium ore."
Hell yeah, we did it!
We did it!
We have completed the mission.
Mission... complete.
All right, operation complete. We're heading back now.
So this is Emerium ore...
All right, we've got it.
So this is Emerium ore...
Phew, and that's one job done!
Heeey!
Oh! You pulled it off, nice work.
So you've come, you lousy heroes!
I am the Kaima Robot, Metaheavy!
Beyond here lies the reservoir. It's a vital facility, so get out of here!!
So you mean to defeat me, do you?
Interesting!! But you lot...

notes.note: Pseudo GN Drive rendered 'pseudo-Solar Furnace' (literal Solar Furnace term; 'pseudo' kept since #0.6 plays on it); not in glossary. 'Operation Area A/B/C' used for the area labels (no earlier English yet; story_026-030 untranslated).
Lockon catchphrase rendered 'I'm aiming and firing!!' to match story_022. #0.3, #0.5, #0.9 and other unlabelled near-duplicates are alternate variants of the labelled line before them.
Unlabelled; taken as Cherudim joking to the party (same scene, his voice).
Sentence runs across #0.3-#0.4; cut at the matching point (comma, lowercase continuation).
Direction: Deathscythe Hell asks the party -> 'We're counting on you for the Gundanium alloy.'.

Labelled Zero. Uncertain whether this is Ultraman Zero or Wing Zero (Heero): the space-mine remark suits Heero, and #0.14 ('one of those Leo things') looks like Ultraman Zero's own variant. Wording works for either.

#0.6-#0.21 are party-leader variant pairs; labels unreliable (#0.15 'W (Philip)'). Subject of 'fought Leos once' restored as 'we' (the party fought Leos together in story_021); the 'understand' lines kept first person. Voices by register: #0.12-13 polite, #0.18-19 Momotaros-style, #0.21 cocky.
Maganac honorific on Sandrock -> 'Master Sandrock', matching 'Master Deathscythe Hell' in story_025.
Unlabelled; read as Heavyarms warning the Maganac Corps, who answer in #0.30 (humble register). Could also be a party-leader line.
#0.2-#0.10 are party-leader variants of the mission-complete reaction; #0.11 '???' is Cherudim approaching (he speaks in #0.12).
Unlabelled #0.3, #0.6, #0.7 taken as Metaheavy continuing; #0.7 trails off as in the source (scene continues past this file).

report: 80/80 rows. Uncertain: 0234.4-5 'Zero' label may be Wing Zero rather than Ultraman Zero; 0234.29 speaker inferred as Heavyarms; leader-variant subjects in 0234.8-21 restored as 'we' (fought) / 'I' (understand). Not in glossary: pseudo-Solar Furnace, Operation Area A/B/C, Leo (as in story_021), Kaima Robot (from Kaima); 'MS' kept as abbreviation.
